title: How to Get Clients From YouTube: The B2B Playbook
description: Views don't pay invoices. Here is the exact system B2B businesses use to turn YouTube videos into booked sales calls, without a big following.

title: YouTube Video Ideas for Business: Stop Brainstorming, Start Stealing Proof
description: A step-by-step method for finding video ideas with proven demand: comment mining, outlier research, and competitor gap analysis. Plus a starter idea list for B2B.

title: YouTube Script Writing for Business Videos: Hooks, Structure, and the No-Pitch Ending
description: How to script a business YouTube video that keeps buyers watching: the 8-second hook, the 3-part intro, retention loops, and why you should never pitch.

title: YouTube Strategy for Business Owners: Goal, Buyer, Demand, Then Videos
description: Most business channels fail because they start with video ideas. The right order: business goal, buyer psychology, demand proof, formats, then a 12-week plan.

title: How Often Should a Business Post on YouTube? Less Than You Think
description: Daily uploads are for entertainment channels. For business channels, one good video a week beats seven rushed ones. Here is the math and the practice loop behind it.

title: B2B YouTube Lead Generation: Turn Viewers Into Booked Calls
description: A YouTube channel becomes a lead engine when every video has a next step. The video-to-call pipeline: lead magnets, email, and booking pages that convert.
